name: Koku
source:
Dodogama True Wyverian. Born and raised in the village, he never knew the outside world, and his dad always fears for his safety whenever he brings up the topic. 

When the traders return, he listens to them for hours while requesting items, though his curiosity can get out of hand sometimes.
